description: Says where a thread stands, and optionally where it stands in the pipeline. Both are recorded as decided by a person, so a later reading by Iris keeps them. To set the same status on several threads, give conversation_id the list of their ids, in ONE call rather than one call per thread: the answer then lists in "results" the outcome of each thread in the order given ("ok", with its "result" or its "error") and counts "succeeded" and "failed". Each thread passes exactly the checks it would alone, so one refused or out of reach ("not found") leaves the others done, and the call is an error only when none succeeded.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it, or a list of up to 50 ids to do the same to every one of them in a single call.

deal_stage.description: Where the thread stands in the pipeline, in your own vocabulary, up to 128 characters. An empty string clears it.

status.description: Where the thread stands: "open" for one nobody has taken, "customer_reply" when the contact has written back, "answered" once we replied, "delivery_failed" when our reply bounced, "in_progress" while someone works on it, "closed" when it is over.

name: set_conversation_status
title: Set the status of a conversation
